title: Hold Me In The Low End
description: A bass-led garage-house roller at 132 BPM where a warm saturated sub and a sidechained pad do the breathing. Shuffled 808 hats and felt-piano chords carry an euphoric-melancholic groove that climbs to two peaks, where a chopped, pitched vocal phrase punches in, with a quiet valley in between.
